canonical_title: Anthropic retires legacy Workbench and experimental prompt tools APIs
aliases: Anthropic experimental prompt tools API retirement
treatment: Repeat only for confirmed shutdown timing, replacement APIs/features, migration tooling, or a rollback/extension.
known_facts: Anthropic scheduled legacy Claude Console Workbench access to end on August 17, 2026.
Saved prompts, prompt versions, variables, and evals from the legacy Workbench are not supported in the refreshed stateless Workbench.
Anthropic scheduled /v1/experimental/generate_prompt, /v1/experimental/improve_prompt, and /v1/experimental/templatize_prompt for retirement on August 17, 2026; after removal, requests return errors.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic confirms the retirement has completed or publishes an exact shutdown time.
Anthropic extends or rolls back the shutdown.
Anthropic introduces replacement prompt-management or evaluation APIs.
notes: Effective-date hard delta. At 12:00 JST the official docs still describe the August 17 retirement date without an exact time, so this record does not assert that shutdown has already completed.
